title: ShunJian Sword
description: A powerful sword that deals 2.1 billion damage, makes you fly, and grants invincibility. All features can be toggled in config.
body:
Instant Blade is a powerful weapon mod designed for players who want to experience god-like power in Minecraft. The sword features an insane 2.147 billion damage, enough to one-shot any entity in the game. When swung, it creates a massive 30x3 area-of-effect attack, damaging every entity in its path.

While holding the sword, players gain creative flight and complete invincibility through max-level resistance, absorption, fire resistance, and water breathing effects. The sword has no attack cooldown and infinite durability, allowing for unlimited use.

All features can be individually enabled or disabled through the configuration file, giving you full control over your gameplay experience. Whether you want a simple overpowered weapon or a complete god-mode experience, Instant Blade delivers.

Configuration Options:

Enable/Disable void damage type

Enable/Disable one-hit kill

Set custom damage value (up to 2.147B)

Enable/Disable range attack (distance/width/height adjustable)

Enable/Disable flight ability

Enable/Disable invincibility effects

Enable/Disable no cooldown

Enable/Disable infinite durability

Toggle particle effects and messages
